## Activity

During January 2025, Central Eye Clinic completed 190 captures. Activity proceeded as expected during the reporting period, with the submitted captures available for image review and subsequent grading. No new equipment faults were raised by staff this month.

## Image quality

Image quality remained suitable for almost all submitted captures. Graders recorded 1 set as ungradable, representing 0.5 per cent of captures. The ungradable result should be considered in routine quality monitoring, while the remaining images were available for grading.

## Grading

A total of 58 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 9 days. These results provide the month’s summary of grading outcomes for Central Eye Clinic and should be used alongside the image-quality information when reviewing site performance.
